content.comment_body: I know this topic has likely been discussed previously. I've read through the forum and reviewed examples, but haven't had much success so far. I'm trying to set up two pumps in a lead/lag arrangement and want to alternate their active cycles as the wetwell fills. Four normally open float switches are installed: one for all off, one for lead on with timer off, one for lag on, and one for high alarm. I'm still learning how [product_name] works and have spent several days trying to make this function correctly.

Hi, I don't fully understand the setup, but you might find some useful ideas in resources about controlling pump pairs. You could also look at application examples for [product_name] for further guidance. Regards,
